text:
nina_sales: Heads-up — XCorp wants a strict 2‑week airgapped POC. Requirements they listed: no outbound telemetry at all, offline installer + signed bundle, upgrade window <= 2h, monthly security patches, quarterly feature upgrades, and legal needs offline activation flow + licensing language. Can we support fully airgapped? cc @devon @maria.g @samir_sre @legal_sg

devon: Yes — we support an offline installer workflow. Two options: (1) online-assisted install (temporarily allow egress to our license service) or (2) fully offline with an activation/license file they upload. If they choose online-assisted, minimal egress only during install for activation. IPs we use if needed: `52.24.10.0/24`, `34.120.0.0/16`. Example firewall allow list snippet:```allow from 52.24.10.0/24 to 443```

maria.g: For the POC I'd recommend fully offline mode to meet their no-telemetry requirement. We package a signed tarball + signature and a LICENSE.JWT they feed to the installer. Upgrade cadence: full feature upgrades can be deferred; we can produce security-only delta bundles monthly. Full upgrades (with migrations) are typically <30m, but heavy DB migrations can hit ~90m — so 2h window is tight but doable with staging and rolling nodes.

samir_sre: Telemetry: our default telemetry is opt-in for private deployments. For enterprise/private we can ship with `telemetry.enabled=false`. We also provide an offline audit log exporter and an offline health-check report they can upload to us for support. KMS/HSM support: yes — customer keys remain local; we can integrate with their vault or HSM.

legal_sg: Licensing / contract: propose a subscription model with an offline activation token process. We'll need them to sign an offline SOW and acceptance criteria. Also flagging export controls — if models include restricted weights we'll need export paperwork. I'll send our offline SOW template and the addendum for airgapped deployments.

jess_engineer: Installer examples:```./redwood-installer --mode offline --bundle redwood-bundle-2026-03-01.tar.gz --license /tmp/license.jwt --target /opt/redwood``` After copy run:```sha256sum redwood-bundle-2026-03-01.tar.gz``` and verify against `redwood-bundle-2026-03-01.sha256` and then:```redwood-verify --sig redwood-bundle.sig redwood-bundle-2026-03-01.tar.gz``` We sign bundles with a hardware key; customer can verify locally.

nina_sales: Customer also wants selective patching: security patches monthly but feature releases quarterly. Can we deliver that without forcing a full re-install?

devon: Yes — we support delta patching. Deltas are cumulative and applied via our offline patch CLI. Note: delta patches require you to be on a supported baseline (e.g., X >= 1.2). We'll produce a delta bundle that only touches CVE fixes and critical libs. No telemetry required for patch application.

katie_support: I'll prep the POC runbook/checklist for them — includes firewall rules, preflight checks, disk requirements, backup steps, and a verification checklist. Preflight commands example:```/opt/redwood/bin/redwood preflight --check-disk --check-ports --check-db-conn``` Also adding a note: plan for DB backup + snapshot before any migration; rolling upgrade recommended for HA.

nina_sales: Great — next steps: @legal_sg to send SOW template, @jess_engineer to attach the signed-bundle verification doc and delta patch guidance, @katie_support to share runbook. I'll schedule a dry-run demo for next Wed morning 10:00 PT. :calendar: :thumbsup:
